name: Spotify Queue TV Mode
description: Improves the queue panel readability with larger text and track art on TV

params.css: [class*='Queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'], [class*='queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'] { min-height: 60px !important; padding: 10px 16px !important; } [class*='Queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'] img, [class*='queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row'] img { width: 48px !important; height: 48px !important; border-radius: 6px !important; } [class*='Queue'] span, [class*='queue'] span { font-size: 17px !important; } [class*='Queue'] h2, [class*='queue'] h2 { font-size: 24px !important; margin-bottom: 16px !important; } [class*='Queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row']:hover, [class*='queue'] [data-testid='tracklist-row']:focus-within { background: rgba(29,185,84,0.12) !important; outline: 2px solid #1db954 !important; border-radius: 8px !important; }
